# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.11

- Open Transfers directly from mobile Workspaces. See native progress, transfer details, completed activity, and interrupted downloads that can resume.
- Mobile File Browser keeps New Folder in the current folder’s toolbar, simplifies item actions, and lets you choose a name and destination for duplicates.
- The AirPlay player can retry at the last confirmed position after wake. HEVC Matroska streams handle the segment layout that blocked the reported Apple TV retry.
